summary: Processa Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) supplementing its July 29, 2026 report on the completed acquisition of Vidya Therapeutics, a Delaware corporation. The amendment adds audited Vidya financials for fiscal years 2025 and 2024, unaudited interim statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, and unaudited pro forma combined Processa figures. No new price, premium, or closing terms were disclosed; the deal closed July 23, 2026. What to watch: integration risk and the combined entity's cash runway, as pro forma statements quantify the enlarged cost base.
